description: Overstory collection schema profile (docs/overstory-spec/06-child-backings.md section 2.4). Locations are 1-based lines and columns counted in Unicode scalar values; a reject without a location binds only its code. Messages are not normative. Generated source parts repeat a template with {i} and {i+1} replaced by the zero-based index and its successor; a {"$repeat": v, "count": n} value expands to an array of n copies of v.

schemas.name: basic
schemas.source:
overstory-schema-version = 1
overstory-primary-key = ["id"]
overstory-child-name = "slug"

row = {
  id: tstr,
  slug: tstr,
  title: tstr,
  ? description: tstr,
  quantity: 0..1000
}

schemas.name: types
schemas.source:
overstory-schema-version = 1
; No primary key: rows are read-only positional projections.
status = "draft" / "done"
tag = tstr
point = { x: number, y: number }
row = {
  status: status,
  tags: [* tag],
  ? points: [+ point],
  flag: bool,
  maybe: tstr / null,
  count: uint,
  delta: nint / 0,
  ratio: 0.0..1.0,
  below: 0...10,
  answer: 42,
  big: int,
  nothing: nil,
  either: tstr / int,
}

schemas.name: open-maps
csv-cell-policy
schemas.source:
overstory-schema-version = 1
overstory-primary-key = ["code"]
row = {
  code: tstr,
  ? note: tstr,
  score: number / null,
  ? level: uint,
  active: bool,
  label: tstr,
}

schemas.name: csv-undeclared-columns
composite-key
layout-and-comments
schemas.source:
; Comments, metadata, and formatting are part of the fingerprint.
row = {
  "display name": label,   ; a text-literal member key
  id: tstr,                ; declared after its use
  ? notes: [* label],
}
label = tstr
overstory-schema-version = 1
